install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; if [ "$(bun --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "1.4.5" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" bash -s "bun-v1.4.5"; fi; grep -qxF 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' >> ~/.bashrc; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; bun install --frozen-lockfile; [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env
